motion.name: fast
motion.purpose: Day-chip selection and small state changes.

rules: One blue primary action per screen; orange/red only for urgency.
Never use outline or outlineVariant as a text color; use onSurfaceVariant.
Urgency must be conveyed by text or remaining time as well as color.
Cards are flat white/charcoal with 1px hairline borders and 18px radius.
Phone uses bottom navigation; desktop uses a left rail.
Phone timetable shows all seven days of the week grid on one screen with no horizontal scroll; wider layouts may scroll horizontally when column width is enlarged.
No gradients, glass, or decorative world-building.
